talks.title: After Hours: Nighttime Culture at DEF CON 30
talks.teaser: Ry captures the after-dark energy, hallway cons, social gatherings, and late-night festivities across DEF CON 30 venues.
talks.summary:
In this lively performance showcase from the DEF CON 30 After Hours track, nighttime hacker culture and nerdcore hip-hop take center stage in an energetic music video. The track opens at 00:10 with nostalgic references to vintage computing, name-checking the Commodore 64 and floppy disk disaster recovery before launching into the hacker anthem at 00:45: "Drink all the booze, hack all the things."

The performance continues at 01:24 with clever verses touching on modern hardware hacking, replacing obsolete tech with Raspberry Pis, and cracking CAPTCHA protections. At 01:45, the lyrics dive into classic technical vulnerability concepts, weaving references to printf format strings, shellcode execution, and Wi-Fi Pineapple wireless attacks into a celebration of DEF CON's vibrant nighttime party culture. talks.title: Violin Ninja
talks.teaser: Violin Ninja performance clip from DEF CON 30.
talks.summary:
This DEF CON 30 After Hours video captures an impromptu musical performance and interview with the "Violin Ninja" in the bustling hallways of the conference venue.

[00:42] The feature documents the artist performing dynamic, high-energy violin music for conference attendees walking between village areas and competition stages. The performer shares the story of busking with electric violin instruments at DEF CON [02:11], reflecting on the creative energy, hacker culture, and unique community atmosphere that define the hacker convention experience outside the technical lecture halls.
